pmdi.title: Imide-Based Multielectron Anolytes as High-Performance Materials in Nonaqueous Redox Flow Batteries
pmdi.evidence_scope: Parent monoimides support one reversible reduction; PMDI diimides support two. Grafted asymmetric caps are new designs.

ndi.title: Ethylene Glycol-Functionalization of Naphthalene Diimides in Nonaqueous Redox Flow Batteries: Balance Between Solubility, Diffusivity, and Crossover
ndi.evidence_scope: Parent NDI two-electron chemistry and EG-chain trade-offs. Abstract describes nucleophilic substitution; no claim that asymmetric N-caps reproduce measured compounds.
ndi.access: Primary abstract inspected; SI retrieval returned HTTP 403

quinone.title: Effect of Cycling Ion and Solvent on the Redox Chemistry of Substituted Quinones and Solvent-Induced Breakdown of the Correlation between Redox Potential and Electron-Withdrawing Power of Substituents
quinone.evidence_scope: Parent quinone reduction chemistry and strong ion/solvent dependence, not measurements of proposed grafted structures.

viologen.title: Two electron utilization of methyl viologen anolyte in nonaqueous organic redox flow battery
viologen.evidence_scope: Methyl viologen two-electron utilization with TFSI in MeCN. No transfer of demonstrated performance to PF6 or asymmetric grafted ether derivatives.

glycol_viologen.title: A prototype of high-performance two-electron non-aqueous organic redox flow battery operated at -40 C
glycol_viologen.evidence_scope: Glycolated viologen/phenothiazine parent design rationale; exact proposed asymmetric benzyl derivatives unmeasured.

phenothiazine.title: A stable two-electron-donating phenothiazine for application in nonaqueous redox flow batteries
phenothiazine.evidence_scope: 3,7-methoxy donor substitution stabilizes a parent N-ethyl phenothiazine dication; proposed N-benzyl derivative still requires validation.

glycol_phenothiazine.title: Tailoring Two-Electron-Donating Phenothiazines To Enable High-Concentration Redox Electrolytes for Use in Nonaqueous Redox Flow Batteries
glycol_phenothiazine.evidence_scope: Specifically substituted 3,7-dialkoxy phenothiazines give two oxidation events. Does not justify two electrons for unsubstituted phenothiazines.

d3tales.title: D3TaLES public computational dataset
d3tales.evidence_scope: Local D3TaLES parent computed properties; no experimental evidence or production grafted energies.
